display_long_description:
🎣 **Catch crazy fish, ride creature boats and take on giant bosses with your friends,!**

Grab your rod, jump on your boat and see what's biting!

### 🐟 Creatures that fight
When the fish rests, **REEL IT IN!** When it fights, **SLOW DOWN!** Don't let it get away!
[media]

### 🌟 Catch them all
Every water has its own fish, from teeny tiny to crazy monsters. Fill your booklet and show off your biggest catch!
[media]

### 🦀 GIANT catches
Team up with your lobby to battle huge bosses. Hook their weak spots, knock off their armor and reel them in together!
[media]

### 🌊 Explore new waters
Sail to the 25 different areas in the world. 
[media]

### ✨ Epic rods
Level up from a simple pole to rods that sparkle, glow and blaze. Every upgrade unlocks stronger rods that catch bigger fish!
[media]

### 🐉 Ride creature boats
Steer creature boats with, make them faster and bring friends aboard. Pick your favorite skin, saddle and reins. On land, your boat shrinks and follows you like a pet!
[media]

**Grab your friends and let's go fishing!** 🎣
